title: Wife's support during husband's medical training becomes key in divorce asset battle
summary_full: An Alabama appeals court reversed a divorce property settlement after finding that a lower court wrongly excluded a surgeon's medical-business interests, acquired during his marriage, from marital assets. His wife had supported the household while he completed medical training. The case has been sent back for a fresh valuation and division of the couple's property.
